caveats: Clean re-baseline 2026-05-26: all measurements in this file replaced by fresh A/B runs. Aggregate shifted from contaminated +39% to clean +31% — artifact contamination was inflating Opus save rates. Opus still saves substantially more than Sonnet (31% vs 20%) but the gap is smaller than the contaminated runs suggested.
Per-skill picture remains bimodal after re-baseline:

- Scaffolding / cross-file-cascade skills (new-solar-system 73%, new-enemy 70%, new-story 34%, equipment 48%, new-migration 36%, new-perk 25%): recipe still compresses cold dependency-graph discovery — pattern holds after re-baseline.

- Audit / orchestration skills (content-audit -25%, modular-architecture-audit -4%, balance-review -12%, save-roundtrip-audit +15%): cost-more or near-break-even. Several sign-flipped from contaminated runs: content-audit +6%→-25%, balance-review +40%→-12%.

Cross-portfolio takeaway: skill SHAPE matters more than model. The re-baseline confirms scaffolding skills genuinely save more on Opus; audit skills remain cost-more or break-even. The contaminated aggregate overstated audit skill saves.
